To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
domain specific play based preschool curricula, with regular coaching and support, is our strongest hope for improving instructional quality at scale.

the strongest hope model has been implemented with six key features: (1) a specific domain based curriculum, (2) a highly scripted curriculum, (3) teacher input into the curriculum, (4) time for planning, (5) real time data collection, and (6) training for administrators.
the strongest hope model of professional development for preschool teachers is a promising approach that can lead to improved teacher instructional practice and child outcomes.
